description: This file is a Java JUnit test class named RmTypeDefsTest. It creates a temporary directory with Java source files defining typedefs and annotations, compiles them using Eclipse JDT BatchCompiler, runs a tool called RmTypeDefs on the output, and performs various checks on the generated files and class contents. The focus is on testing the removal of specific typedef-related symbols and verifying class contents post-processing.

classes.name: RmTypeDefsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for creating, compiling, and testing a Java source setup involving typedef annotations and classes, and verifying removal of specific symbols after running RmTypeDefs.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Main test method that creates source files, compiles them, runs the RmTypeDefs tool, and performs checks on generated classes and directory contents.

methods.name: assertDoesNotContainBytes
methods.description: Checks that the class file does not contain specific symbols, particularly targeting the 'Visibility' symbol to verify its removal.

methods.name: getDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the directory contents, listing files and subdirectories recursively.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Helper for getDirectoryContents, recursively appends directory and file names to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: deleteDir
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and all its contents, used for cleanup.
